description: Eight multipliers, each giving the product of the two signals patched into its row, with a summed output of all eight

params.text: Chooses whether the outputs carry the plain product of the two inputs or that product divided by 10, which keeps two 10V signals within the output range

inputs.text: One of the two signals multiplied together on that row; with nothing patched it takes the A signal of the nearest row above that has one, or 0V if there is none
One of the two signals multiplied together on that row; with nothing patched it takes the B signal of the nearest row above that has one, and with none patched at all the row passes A unchanged

outputs.text: The product of the two signals on that row, clamped to -12V and 12V
The sum of all eight row outputs, which makes the module a mixer

notes: every row works polyphonically, and an output carries as many channels as the wider of its two inputs
